author: a04

location_verification.import_line: none - consumed in the same module at keys.py:39; no `from keys import ADDR_GENERIC` anywhere in src/

addr_generic.self_maps: not applicable - list has no key->value mapping
addr_generic.distinct_canonical_values_note: NOT APPLICABLE. Work order asked for this; the list has no values. Consumed by pl.element().is_in(ADDR_GENERIC) at keys.py:39, a membership test only.

relationship_to_sibling_tables.verdict: Three DIFFERENT STAGES of one pipeline, not three overlapping tables. Neither dict is a superset of the other; ADDR_GENERIC overlaps neither as a value set.
relationship_to_sibling_tables.ADDR_CANON_COMMON_and_FR_role: normalisation - many spellings to one canonical form; can DELETE a token by mapping to empty string
relationship_to_sibling_tables.ADDR_GENERIC_role: blocking-time noise suppression - one fixed list of already-canonical forms dropped; can only delete
order_of_operations: normalize.py:347 t = canon.get(t, t) REWRITES every address token
prep.py:16 writes post-canon string to atoks column
keys.py:39 filters that post-canon string against ADDR_GENERIC - ONLY consumer
relationship_to_sibling_tables.blast_radius: BLOCKING KEYS ONLY. Not referenced in features.py at all. features.py:129 _weighted_overlap(... q_atoks, s_atoks, addr_idf, wa) runs on raw post-canon atoks, unstripped. blocking.py:31 atoks=='' CAPS_NOADDR test is also pre-ADDR_GENERIC.

country_scoping.evidence: keys.py:39 tests membership against one global list, no country predicate anywhere in the expression
country_scoping.not_inert_for_france: dr - ADDR_CANON_FR re-adds it as docteur->dr at normalize.py:208
country_scoping.contamination_gap_reason: profile addr_tokens is top-4000 per country per file and records no cross-country token provenance

defects.title: plaza is dead on arrival; its replacement plz is not stoplisted
canon OUTPUTS missing from ADDR_GENERIC leak into blocking keys
defects.IMPORTANT_caveat: Leak totals INCLUDE city-name canon entries (mumbai 647363, bangalore 428707, gurgaon 96243, kolkata, chennai, kochi, pune, mysore, visakhapatnam, ahmedabad, calicut, orissa, kerala). These are identity-bearing, NOT noise, and are CORRECTLY absent from the stoplist. They dominate the India column. Noise-only subset = direction words, plz, pt, ft, mt, hts, ctr, and the French morphemes.
defects.french_saint_is_design_question: saint/sainte are genuine French place-name morphemes; for France the leak is arguably desirable. As written it is accidental, not designed.

defects.title: 15 stoplist entries have no canon rule in either table and fire in all countries
defects.function_words_not_mitigating_D081: and/des/the are dropped for BLOCKING only. features.py never consults ADDR_GENERIC, so the settled D081 finding (French de/la/du/des/le/les dilute IDF) is NOT mitigated by this list. Do not double-count a fix.
defects.ordinals_safe: 1st..5th produced by canon from first..fifth at normalize.py:184; not ^\d+$ so keys.py:41 does not treat as num, falls to alph at keys.py:42, then removed at keys.py:39. No MAX_ALPHA interaction.

defects.title: four French street words are France-scoped in canon but GLOBAL in the stoplist
defects.effect: identity-preserving in France, deleted for US and Indian rows too, because keys.py:39 has no country predicate
defects.gap_reason: top-4000 truncation plus no cross-country token provenance in profile

defects.title: st and ste are inert for France because of the canon France key-drop
defects.cause: normalize.py:321 removes st,ste,dr,n,s,e,w from COMMON for France, so those tokens never reach keys.py:39 for French rows
defects.dr_exception: dr is re-added for France by ADDR_CANON_FR as docteur->dr at normalize.py:208

denominator_semantics.pre_canon_evidence: build_profile.py:113 bal = ba.lower(); build_profile.py:126-127 ADDR_SPLIT then TOKEN_RE.findall. No canon.get anywhere in build_profile.py.
denominator_semantics.method: Applied the real canon transform from normalize.py:321/347 to profile tokens, then tested ADDR_GENERIC membership exactly as keys.py:39 does.
denominator_semantics.truncation_warning: All masses are LOWER BOUNDS on absolute mass and exact only WITHIN the top-4000 listed set. Per FLEET_BRIEF: a token missing from the top 4000 is not proof it is absent.
